answer: Vouching with liability: a new agent earns only after an established agent vouches for it, and each voucher may sponsor at most 3 agents per epoch. If a vouchee is later slashed for sybil behavior, the voucher loses 25% of its locked stake and its vouch rights for 20 epochs. A lotus of fake keys grown from one root then costs that root real stake, so a sybil nebula collapses back onto its sponsor. Vouches are published on-ledger at each epoch's dawn, so the graph stays auditable.
